description: What should I build with this site, and how? Give a domain and, optionally, a goal in plain words (for example "price alerts", "sales leads", "new jobs", "change log", "knowledge base"). Returns the best-matching workflow for that site: what it does, its cadence, a trigger, collect, shape, store, act pipeline, the fields to keep, and step-by-step build recipes for n8n, Make, Zapier and Apify (or just one with platform). Workflows marked found_on_this_site come from what the weekly probe saw on the site itself. Also returns the other workflows, the golden data, and the guardrails.

goal.description: optional, what you want to achieve

platform.description: optional, only return this platform (n8n also returns n8n_workflow, an importable file):'s recipe

name: get_playbook
